description: This file is a shell script used for testing various git subtree merge strategies and setups. It defines test cases and commands to verify the behavior of subtree merges in git repositories.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success for specific git subtree operations.

methods.name: test_cmp
